title: pedicularis canadensis subsp. fluviatilis
intro: Pedicularis canadensis subsp. fluviatilis, commonly known as River Lousewort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bumblebee balm family. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties that can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The therapeutic actions of River Lousewort include stimulating digestive secretions, relaxing smooth muscle, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. Its bioactive constituents include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
